## Highlights
### Fixed
- Keep Space navigation centered and Archive controls reachable as more Spaces are added - Continue typing with the same caret or selection after returning to a webpage tab on Mac - Use compatible browser extension actions directly from webpage context menus - Keep mouse back and forward navigation within the webpage or sidebar under the pointer - Keep new-window links inside Peek and Quick Window instead of hiding them in background tabs - Start loading tabs opened from links right away, with an option to select them automatically
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
